pages.text: You might want more mounds, either to obtain more resources or obtain new Mounds capable of placing a Structure Block. There are two ways to achieve this:$(br2)The first one is to let a chest with at least one food item (such as a piece of Biomass) not too far from a Mound. Stage 3 and 4 Mounds will eventually detect it and grow a Mound on this chest, feeding on the food at their disposal.

The second way is to wait for Scamper. Scampers are strange looking Spore creatures, which you can recognize easily as they look weird and walk veeeeery slowly. Stage 4 Mounds spawn them every 10 minutes. If a Scamper exists for more than 10 minutes, they will usually turn into two or three Mounds, or more rarely into a Gastgeber, which is a dangerous evolved creature that has stronger infecting capabilites than a Mound, and can move, although it cannot place structure blocks.
